R9-1: closed — the re-enrollment's make-good test now names the payment it looks at (the latest payment toward the debit's due date) before testing it (no return points at it, dated after the return, within the grace days) and says the debit is not made good when a return points at that payment; two other sentences of the same shape (the returned-payment fee's most-recent-return scope and the late fee's card-payment netting) were reworded to select first and test second.
